alarm_contract: A short Boolean report is event acquisition in simulation, not persistent force or evidence the contact became safe.

official.note: Landing control under R14 detector is separate from R25 yaw+default my_torque. Reported official impacts are horizontal only.

timing_definitions: First delay uses scheduled input as in R24. All attributed edges in lists are measured from the first committed nonzero sample, which may be one tick later. Coverage and per-case protection are separate.
